target.title: test(qa): run the real CLI channel picker
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `cli-channel-picker` QA scenario only linked to mocked Vitest coverage, so it could report maturity coverage without launching the product CLI, crossing the interactive prompt boundary, or proving that onboarding persisted configuration.

## Why This Change Was Made

Convert the scenario to a script-backed producer that:

- forces a fresh CLI startup build;
- launches `openclaw configure --section channels` through the existing PTY helper under an isolated `OPENCLAW_HOME`;
- drives the real picker through Telegram setup and the final DM-policy prompt;
- requires successful process exit and validates the written plugin, channel, mention-gate, and wizard metadata;
- emits the shared QA script evidence envelope with a sanitized transcript and config-assertion artifact;
- terminates stalled processes and records failed evidence instead of accepting a preview or helper-only simulation.

The implementation deliberately reuses the repository PTY wrapper, owned ANSI sanitizer, and shared evidence writer rather than adding another harness abstraction. A follow-up complexity review removed the initial process adapter, injected fake runner, and mock-only evidence tests, reducing the producer and focused tests by about 37%.

This PR is AI-assisted. I reviewed the implementation and understand the behavior and evidence paths.

## User Impact

No product behavior changes. QA coverage for the CLI channel picker now proves the real interactive user path and persisted configuration, making release and maturity evidence more trustworthy.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/e2e/qa-lab/config/cli-channel-picker.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/scenario-catalog.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/test-file-scenario-runner.test.ts --reporter=dot` — 50 tests passed on the rebased head.
- Local script producer — forced a fresh `cliStartup` build, completed the real picker, wrote Telegram configuration, emitted `pass` evidence, and retained no synthetic token or ANSI fragments.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwnjx7cargk8vj5x30r1jfeb` — `check:changed`, the same 50 focused tests, and fresh-build real picker proof passed. Crabbox wrapper result: `exitCode=0`, `runStatus=succeeded`, `commandMs=303552`, `totalMs=317692`, `syncDelegated=true`.
- Backing hydration run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28693611847 — the Testbox step may appear cancelled after the successful command because the one-shot wrapper stops the externally managed lease; the wrapper JSON above is the command result per the repository Testbox contract.
- PR CI is running for exact head `75b0f3af31a7529ccf8c07c978738b158a4a2fa9` on base `9d68f877ac3ea28c1abffaf7a043c8c916bea217`.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --prompt-file /tmp/cli-picker-clawsweeper-review.md --stream-engine-output` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
